_comment: Sample data for demo.py. Competitor items are REAL publications by these firms — titles and URLs verified live on 2026-09-01; summaries are short condensations in the pipeline's style. Client companies (Nordwind, Cantara, Veltena, Brenner) are entirely fictional and appear only in the newsletter demo, never in the dashboard.

signals.title: The agentic organization: A new operating model for AI
signals.summary: Describes the agentic organization as the next operating paradigm: AI-first workflows, real-time personalisation, and cost structures decoupled from headcount growth. A foundational piece for AI-era operating model design.

signals.title: Seizing the agentic AI advantage
signals.summary: QuantumBlack report on why agentic AI pilots stall and how to move from scattered use cases to redesigned workflows with agents embedded end to end.

signals.title: Scaling agentic AI with data transformations
signals.summary: Argues that scale requires federated governance: business domains own day-to-day oversight of agent-enabled workflows while central teams maintain shared platforms and guardrails.

signals.title: Rewriting the Global Capability Center Playbook: Scaling Maturity with AI
signals.summary: Finds most GCCs remain focused on delivery execution, with only 8% advanced across the dimensions most critical to enterprise value; sets out an AI-led maturity path from execution hub to capability hub.

signals.title: GCCs: Dinosaurs or Unicorns?
signals.summary: Earlier perspective on the Indian GCC ecosystem and whether captives scale into innovation engines; useful baseline for the current maturity debate.

signals.title: An Operating Model for the Age of AI
signals.summary: Argues AI breaks the link between headcount and output, forcing a rethink of how work is structured, roles are defined, and spans and layers are set.

signals.title: Is Agentic AI the Inflection Point for Scaling ERP Transformations?
signals.summary: Examines agents as accelerators of ERP programmes and names the blockers: unclear operating models for human-agent interaction and immature agentic tooling.

signals.title: Global Shared Services and Outsourcing Survey
signals.summary: Deloitte's flagship GBS survey, built on 2,000+ respondents over eight years: India, the US, and Poland stay the top delivery locations, and half of GBS organisations plan to expand their footprint.

signals.title: 2025 GBS Survey Insights, Part I: Expansion, Locations, and Evolving Models
signals.summary: Survey deep-dive on expansion and location choices: Mexico and Portugal rising as preferred delivery locations alongside the established hubs.

signals.title: 2026 EY Global DNA of the CFO Survey
signals.summary: Flagship CFO survey: 80% of CFOs expect AI-enabled business models to feature significantly in their organisation within 12 months — a demand-side signal for AI-led finance transformation.

signals.title: How AI is transforming financial planning and analysis
signals.summary: Positions GenAI adoption and agentic orchestration as the lever that shifts FP&A from reporting cycles toward continuous, insight-driven planning.

signals.title: KPMG firms recognised as a Leader in ISG Provider Lens GCC Services 2025
signals.summary: Analyst recognition placing KPMG among the leaders for global capability center services — a positioning signal in the increasingly contested GCC advisory market.

signals.title: PwC's AI Agent Survey
signals.summary: Survey of 300 senior executives: 79% report AI agents already adopted and 88% plan budget increases driven by agentic AI; trust drops sharply for high-stakes autonomous use cases.

signals.title: Agentic AI reinvention: Making AI agents accretive to the P&L
signals.summary: Framework for moving agents from pilots to P&L impact, tying agent deployment to workflow redesign and measurable value cases.

signals.title: Generative AI in Operations for AI-Powered Reinvention
signals.summary: Positions GenAI-powered managed services as the successor to labor-based delivery — a structural signal for outsourcing and GBS economics.

signals.title: New Accenture Research Finds that Companies with AI-Led Processes Outperform Peers
signals.summary: Research note: organisations with fully modernised, AI-led processes nearly doubled year over year (9% to 16%) and show 2.5x higher revenue growth than peers.

signals.title: Nordwind Industries announces new group CFO effective January
signals.summary: Leadership change at the top of the finance function. The incoming CFO arrives from a company known for a centralised GBS model — a common precursor to operating model review and a natural engagement window.

signals.title: Nordwind to consolidate European back-office functions in Lisbon hub
signals.summary: Announces consolidation of finance and HR back-office activities into a single European hub. Signals an active shared services agenda with likely demand for transition and process design support.

signals.title: Cantara Group launches group-wide ERP consolidation programme
signals.summary: Multi-year programme to consolidate regional ERP instances onto a single platform. Indicates budget committed to finance infrastructure and openness to transformation partners.

signals.title: Veltena Pharma plans shared services expansion into Krakow
signals.summary: Expansion of the existing shared services footprint with a new Krakow site focused on record-to-report and procurement operations. Direct signal of GBS build-out with near-term advisory needs.

signals.title: Brenner Logistics flags cost programme alongside quarterly results
signals.summary: Quarterly results accompanied by a group-wide cost programme announcement. Cost pressure often precedes shared services and automation initiatives; worth monitoring for scope details.
